blockingFindings.title: Empty guardrail configuration still passes
blockingFindings.issue: `checkGuardrail()` still returns `null` when `loadGuardrails(root)` returns an empty array, and both gate paths treat `null` as a clean pass. That leaves a required guardrail evaluation unavailable but non-blocking whenever the configured guardrail set is empty.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In `checkGuardrail()`, treat an empty required guardrail list as a typed failure, for example `failureKind: "guardrail-unset"` and `failureCode: "GATE_REQUIRED_GUARDRAIL_UNSET"`, instead of returning `null`. Update the R2 test matrix to cover `requiredGuardrail: []` or an equivalent empty configured guardrail source.
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 requires unavailable required evaluations to fail closed. An empty configured guardrail set means no required guardrail evaluation can run, yet the current branch returns `null`, which `runGateFlow()` and `RunGateCommand.execute()` convert to pass behavior.
